svg.title: A convolution slides one small detector along the time axis
svg.desc: The log-mel features of a recording of the word seven, 98 frames wide and 40 mel bands tall. A window five frames wide is outlined at two different times. Each window is multiplied by the same weights W and produces one frame of the output, a strip of 49 frames with 64 channels each. Because the window moves two frames per step, the output has half as many frames as the input.
svg.text: One small detector, slid along the time axis
INPUT: LOG-MEL FEATURES OF "SEVEN", 98 FRAMES × 40 BANDS
The window moves 2 frames per output (stride 2), so 98 frames in become 49 frames out.
